name: Delayed Reaction
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target is unable to react to things going on around her, delaying her action until after your next turn.
